referencePolicy: Reference articles and diagrams were studied for communication techniques. No Elux image pixels were used as inputs for the original illustrations. Chinese illustrations localize the original English illustrations.

Right 30% a separate smaller dashed-outline tray labeled 'Search index' with a small amber 'Proposed' badge; one dotted connector from Discussions to Search index labeled 'Contract'. Rounded rectangular trays, not houses or walls; no database icons within each tray suggesting isolated storage. Keep all labels exactly as specified.
